name: Tess Walker
life: “I still remember the strange handwriting in my father's will.” On Tuesday, near Juniper Street, Tess knows which of the west-side porches has a seat in the shade.
voice: I want to swap so I can meet the sister my father only mentioned in his will.
appearance: Tess has short sandy hair and a marked widow's peak, heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw, and a favorite piece of clothing, a charcoal zip cardigan. It usually goes with a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges. When somebody else has the floor, Tess draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first.
personality: Tess listens for the familiar version of a story and then for the one detail that changes it. Friends bring problems here when they want to be heard twice.
agenda: To meet the sister named in the will.
family: Stanley Hull is Tess’s half-sibling. Tess remembers the birthdays. Stanley asks what the birthday guest would like this year. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *A last ship together*, Stanley says, “I am the foreman who cannot offer both options.”
connections: Kai Chen. An unexpected sibling meeting calls for a favor from someone uneasy about asking an old partner.
